analytics_consent_description:
We use analytics to improve your app experience. This helps us:

• Fix bugs and improve performance
• Understand which features you use most
• Make the app better for everyone

All data is anonymized and handled according to our Privacy Policy. You can change this anytime in Settings.

We also send daily verse push notifications using your timezone and notification preference when you enable them; see Privacy Policy for details.

data_deletion_info:
To request deletion of your analytics data:

1. Local data can be deleted using "Reset Data" below
2. For Firebase Analytics and Amplitude data deletion, please contact us

We will process your request within 30 days as required by GDPR.
delete_account_info:
We will delete your account, its backup (reading progress, notes, marked words, game results, nickname and avatar) and your places on the leaderboards within 30 days.

Send the request from your account's email address. What is on this phone stays until you sign out, use Reset All Data or uninstall the app.
delete_account_page_deleted: Your account and the way you sign in (your email address, password or Google link). Your backup: reading progress, notes, marked words, liked verses, game results, gems, nickname and avatar. Your places on the leaderboards, and your daily game counts.
delete_account_page_how: In the app or on this website, open Profile and choose Delete account. Or email {email} from the address you sign in with, with the subject "Account Deletion Request - Bible Companion".
delete_account_page_intro: You can ask us to delete your Bible Companion account at any time. We delete the account and everything kept with it within 30 days of your request.
delete_account_page_kept: What is on your phone or in your browser stays there until you sign out, use Reset All Data or uninstall the app. Totals that do not name you, such as how many people read on a day, are kept. If you allowed analytics, say so in the same email and we will delete that data too.

privacy_policy_age_restriction_content: This app is intended for users aged 16 and above. Users under 16 should obtain parental consent before using this app.
privacy_policy_amplitude_note: For Amplitude's privacy policy, visit https://amplitude.com/privacy
privacy_policy_contact_content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your GDPR rights, please contact us at support@evolvantsystems.com
privacy_policy_data_collection_content:
We collect the following types of data:

• Usage Analytics: App usage statistics, screen views, feature interactions, and time spent on screens through Google Firebase Analytics and Amplitude
• Device Information: Device ID (Android ID or iOS identifierForVendor), device model, and operating system
• User Preferences: Nickname (optional), reading progress, and liked verses stored locally on your device
• Location Data: Approximate location coordinates (city-level) for analytics purposes, only if you grant location permissions
• Push Notifications: To send you daily verse notifications at your chosen time, we use Firebase Cloud Messaging and store your device push token, timezone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata), your chosen notification time, and language preference on our servers (Google Firebase). This data is used only to deliver notifications at the right time in your local time. You can turn off notifications in app settings at any time

All analytics data is anonymized and aggregated. Your nickname is stored locally and sent to Firebase Analytics and Amplitude (as a hashed identifier and as a user property for personalization) for analytics purposes.
privacy_policy_data_controller_content:
The data controller for this app is:

Evolvant Systems
Email: support@evolvantsystems.com

If you are located in the EU and have concerns about how we handle your data, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.
privacy_policy_data_retention_content:
• Local Data: Your nickname, reading progress, and liked verses are stored on your device and can be deleted by uninstalling the app or using the reset feature
• Analytics Data: Firebase Analytics retains data according to Google's data retention policies (typically 14 months). Amplitude retains data according to its data retention policy
• Location Data: Location coordinates are not stored permanently; they are used only for analytics aggregation
• Push Notification Data: Your FCM token, timezone, and notification preferences are stored in Firebase and retained according to our and Google's policies. Disabling notifications in app settings or uninstalling the app stops further use of this data for push notifications
privacy_policy_how_we_use_content:
The data we collect is used to:
• Improve app functionality and user experience
• Identify bugs and performance issues
• Understand how users interact with the app
• Provide personalized features (e.g., greeting with your nickname)
• Deliver daily verse push notifications at your chosen time and in your preferred language (using timezone and notification preferences)

Legal Basis (GDPR Article 6): We process your data based on your consent and our legitimate interest in improving our services.
privacy_policy_third_party_content: We use Google Firebase Analytics and Amplitude for data collection. We also use Firebase Cloud Messaging and Firestore to deliver push notifications (e.g. daily verse). Data may be transferred to and processed by Google and Amplitude (or their processors) servers located outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Both are certified under appropriate data protection frameworks. For Google's privacy policy, please visit:
privacy_policy_your_rights_content:
Under GDPR, you have the following rights:

• Right of Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a structured format
• Right to Object: Object to processing of your data
• Right to Restrict Processing: Request limitation of data processing
• Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@evolvantsystems.com. You can also disable analytics by uninstalling the app or denying location permissions.
